facts.value: Common-fighter wall-contact entry predicate with source signature bool(Fighter_GObj* gobj). True means it dispatched ftCo_800C1E64 for PassiveWall or PassiveWallJump; false means that local dispatch did not occur, not a guarantee of no side effects in delegated eligibility checks.
facts.rationale: Preserves exact signature and return contract without overclaiming delegated purity or lack of transitions.

evidence.why: Complete guard, dispatch and return paths.
Eligibility includes a further delegated predicate.

facts.value: Reads Fighter.x67E and input.lstick[0].y and returns x67E < p_ftCommonData->x250 OR stick y >= tap_jump_threshold without writes. The detector uses it to select PassiveWallJump versus PassiveWall; nonzero-timer IASA uses it to latch passivewall.x8. The input producer resets x67E on XY press and otherwise increments it up to 255.
facts.rationale: Corrects canonical field spelling and documents both consumers.
Role hypothesis based on the read-only jump-input predicate used both for initial motion selection and pending conversion in IASA; not an original recovered symbol and not a single-caller function.

facts.value: Tests for qualifying recent jump-button timing or upward stick position, supplying both initial PassiveWallJump selection and pending-jump latching during nonzero-timer startup.
facts.rationale: Retains supported jump-input purpose while removing the incorrect sole-caller account.

facts.value: Consumes gobj, motion ID, timer, velocity exponent and float direction. Sets cmd_vars[0], stores negated direction as facing, calls ftCommon_8007E2FC, selects ECB left offset for right-wall-hug or right offset otherwise, and passes it to ftKb_SpecialN_800F1F1C. Enters the supplied motion at frame zero with timer-dependent rate, sets both stick-tilt ages to 254, stores timer/exponent and clears x4/x8. Builds an effect vector from current position and offset and passes it to efAsync_Spawn with x60C queue, kind 2, gfx expression 1|4|8|16|1024 and NULL joint before assigning current x to -(x68C_transNPos.z * -facing_dir - pos_x_offset). Calls ft_80081F2C, ft_800881D8 with character x24 sound data, ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp,12,0), SFX 3 only for timer zero, ftCo_800BFFD0(fp,120,0), and ftColl_8007B760(gobj,x764). Exact external feedback and geometric-alignment semantics remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Replaces unverified semantic glosses with exact canonical data flow and sequencing.

facts.value: Provides shared parameterized entry for the PassiveWall family used by wall-tech detection and ordinary wall jumping: changes the caller-selected motion, initializes startup and velocity-scaling state, computes effect and position values from wall-related collision data, and invokes common movement, effect, sound and other setup helpers. Precise external feedback and contact-alignment meanings are not established here.
facts.rationale: Keeps independently verified shared-entry role without treating rendered aliases or geometric interpretation as proof.

facts.value: Performs entry without local eligibility or range validation. Any nonzero timer starts animation at rate zero; zero starts rate one and additionally plays SFX 3. Stores facing as the supplied float's negation without normalization, sets cmd_vars[0], sets x/y stick-tilt timers to 254, stores action timer/exponent and clears x4/x8. Right-wall-hug selects the left ECB offset; all other cases select the right offset. Effect submission precedes the x-position correction and remaining setup calls. Zero-timer entry does not execute Anim's later decrement-to-zero release assignment.
facts.rationale: States exact branches and boundary behavior rather than broad collision-response claims.

evidence.why: Entry branches and distinct animation release condition.

facts.value: Decrements any nonzero action timer; only a decrement yielding zero plays SFX 8 and restores rate one or converts at the current frame to PassiveWallJump when x8 is latched. Conversion sets y stick-tilt age to 254 and action timer zero. Release assigns facing*passivewall_vel_x to self_vel.x for PassiveWall; otherwise it assigns wall-jump x/y attributes and conditionally scales y by powf(passive_wall_vel_y_base,vel_y_exponent) when walljumpUsed is nonzero. Entry with timer zero skips release assignment. Animation completion enters Fall independently of timer. Negative timers and exceptional float inputs are not locally validated.
facts.rationale: Corrects timer-reset value, exact motion branch and zero-entry boundary.

evidence.why: Complete conversion helper and animation callback.

facts.value: Uses ft_80083318 whenever passivewall.timer is nonzero and ft_800831CC whenever it is zero, including immediate zero-timer entry. Both receive gobj, ftCo_80096CC8 and ft_80082B1C. Zero enables this TU's ordinary physics and interrupt paths but does not prove that Anim's decrement-to-zero launch block ran. Detailed helper distinction, landing consequences and callback retention remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Separates timer truthiness from the release event.

evidence.why: Release condition, timer gates and exact collision dispatch.

facts.value: With nonzero timer, checks only ftCo_800C1E0C; true latches x8 and false leaves the latch unchanged. With zero timer, RETURN_IF checks run in order: ftCo_SpecialAir_CheckInput, ftCo_80095328(gobj,NULL), ftCo_800D7100, ftCo_800C3B10, ftCo_80099A58, ftCo_AttackAir_CheckItemThrowInput, ftCo_800D705C, ftCo_800CB870, cmd_vars[0]==0, and ftCo_800CEE70. Each true condition terminates processing. cmd_vars[0] gates only the final check. Exact gameplay meanings of the address-named external checks remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Retains complete priority and latching without circular reliance on rendered names.

facts.value: Eligible wall contact selects PassiveWall or PassiveWallJump; ordinary wall jumping also reuses the initializer. Nonzero timer begins with paused playback and gates this TU's ordinary physics/interrupt chain while allowing jump latching. Only decrement-to-zero in Anim triggers release sound, rate restoration or queued conversion, and launch assignment. Initial timer zero starts playback at rate one and enables physics/interrupts without that release assignment. Animation completion enters Fall independently of timer. Collision dispatch depends only on timer truthiness, and a skipped local Phys body does not prove the entire engine is motionless.
facts.rationale: Replaces generalized at-zero launch and freeze claims with exact local lifecycle boundaries.

evidence.why: External update contains additional velocity processing.
